tagline: Storage, SMART and disk activity monitoring for ZimaOS/Linux
description:
Self-hosted disk monitoring dashboard with SMART health, temperature,
standby state, activity and RAID information.

**Before installation:** Use **Custom install → Advanced (show more)** and
replace all security placeholders before starting Disk Monitor for the
first time. Set your own `DISK_MONITOR_USERNAME`, choose a
`DISK_MONITOR_PASSWORD` with at least 12 characters, and generate a unique
`DISK_MONITOR_SESSION_SECRET` with at least 32 characters. Do not install
the app with the `CHANGE_ME_...` values unchanged.

Leave `DISK_MONITOR_SESSION_HTTPS_ONLY` set to `false` for normal local
HTTP access. Set it to `true` only when Disk Monitor is served exclusively
over HTTPS.

tips.before_install: Use Custom install → Advanced (show more) before the first start. Change DISK_MONITOR_USERNAME, set a password with at least 12 characters, and generate a unique session secret with at least 32 characters. Do not leave any CHANGE_ME_... placeholder unchanged.
